text_block_list.name: 密着スタッフ
text_block_list.text:
『密着ドキュメンタリーウマ娘
フィルム：ドゥラメンテ』――ということで！

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
Day one of filming, currently 5 AM.
...No one else is here yet, do you always start at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: For the most part.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, until breakfast at 7:00. After that,
I do strength training in my room until it is time for school.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san is taking a photo of her meal...!
Are you going to post it on social media?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No. It is for recording dietary intake.
I compile it alongside my training log.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see! So that's why!

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: Now, between classes during recess...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I use this time to review class material.
I wish to secure as much sleep time at night as possible.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me while you are studying.
I was hoping to borrow your notes from the day I was absent.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah, understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: !? W-What was that sound just now!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... That would be the sound of this notebook, I presume.
Her notebooks are custom-made with steel plates inside.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Notebooks with steel plates inside!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, each volume weighs 10 kg!
Commonly known as dumbbell notebooks!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Every single notebook Duramente-chan uses is like that, you know~! It's so bononoo!

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Training on the track from early dawn,
strength training with study materials during class, reviewing during breaks.

text_block_list.name: Close-up Staff
text_block_list.text:
...
Duramente-san, when do you actually rest?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I take it at night.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whew... R-Right! That makes sense!
Every time I see you, you're always doing something, so I got worried.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you do to relax?
We're in different dorms, so I've always wondered!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by what?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I watch Princess Fighter together with my dorm friends!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: As for me, I often watch cooking channels on UmaTube~! Even though it makes me hungry♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I sleep.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sleep.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What else would one do?

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Tarumae
text_block_list.text: We just gave you a whole bunch of examples!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you being so stoic that you're becoming detached from the secular world?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the program aired, Duramente became a hot topic online as the "Hermit Horse Girl" due to her extreme stoicism.
